request.prompt:
Draw FOUR genuine full-body animation key poses of exactly the chibi FIRE TALISMAN BOY in the immediately preceding reference image, all facing straight FRONT / SOUTH, camera and face orientation fixed. Keep this very cute huge round head, short little body, brown topknot with gold red-gem ornament, amber eyes and smile, red/gold/black Taoist robe, ivory cuffs, yin-yang belt medallion, red tassels, short black trousers and red-gold-black chunky shoes. The anatomical RIGHT hand on screen LEFT holds the red fire-talisman fan, anatomical LEFT hand on screen RIGHT holds the brass ritual bell. Those props never swap. This is walking casually in place, no attacks.
Create a square TWO-BY-TWO equal-cell sprite sheet with four distinctive equally spaced key poses of ONE COMPLETE ordinary walk cycle, read row-major:
TOP LEFT = phase01 RIGHT CONTACT. Anatomical RIGHT foot, which is the shoe on screen LEFT, clearly extends FORWARD toward the viewer and lands low in its cell. Anatomical LEFT foot on screen RIGHT is clearly back, heel lifted, behind and visibly higher. Modest arm counter-swing: bell hand forward, fan hand back.
TOP RIGHT = phase05 RIGHT SUPPORT/PASSING. Anatomical RIGHT foot (screen LEFT) now bears the body weight directly under the torso, planted. Anatomical LEFT leg (screen RIGHT) bends at the knee and its airborne shoe swings forward past the planted right foot. Feet close horizontally and knees clearly in passing rather than contact. Bell and fan nearer middle swing.
BOTTOM LEFT = phase09 LEFT CONTACT. This MUST visibly reverse top-left legs: anatomical LEFT foot, shoe on screen RIGHT, clearly extends FORWARD toward the viewer, lands low in cell. Anatomical RIGHT shoe on screen LEFT is back with lifted heel, visibly higher. Fan hand modestly forward, bell hand modestly back.
BOTTOM RIGHT = phase13 LEFT SUPPORT/PASSING. Anatomical LEFT foot (screen RIGHT) bears weight under torso planted. Anatomical RIGHT leg (screen LEFT) bends and the airborne shoe swings forward past the planted left shoe. This is the opposite support leg from top-right.
Make both shoes clearly visible, with solid plausible legs under the short coat. Do NOT draw the same forward foot in all four cells, do NOT merely change the arms while preserving legs, do NOT make four contact poses. Alternate contact / passing / opposite contact / opposite passing exactly. Small natural sway in robe, ponytail, talismans, bell tassel, with minimal head bob and no head turn. Preserve identical face, costume, proportions and cell scale. Each whole character including topknot and shoe fits inside its cell, its height about93% of the cell, symmetric margin, no clipping, no crossing cell boundaries. Keep feet at near same groundline. Reference stance is identity only; actually redraw four distinct correct leg poses.
Solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere behind characters, no ground shadows, gradients, floors, labels, text, numbers, lines or borders. Four large independently drawn sprites, clean consistent high quality hand-painted Chinese fantasy RPG art.
